lines: Your winter arc will fail if it needs perfect days.
Here is the version that survives.
One. Pick two habits so small you could do them on your worst day.
Two. Write an if then plan. If it is seven o'clock and I am home, then shoes on, ten minute walk.
Three. Draw ninety boxes. Fill one every day. Miss a day, do the small version tomorrow. Miss two, shrink the habit.
